outputs.title: TS6 プロバイオティックPLUS+
outputs.prompt:
Create one photograph for a planned ecommerce image set.
Campaign hero photograph: Clean and credible wellness product composition without invented certificates, doctors or medical symbolism. Create a refined editorial set with directional light, dimensional shadows and breathing room. The product is the focal point. Center its important details so the same photograph can be used for a Banner.
Shared art direction: soft natural neutrals with restrained sage accents.
Preserve the exact source product shape, color, logo, packaging, number of pieces, and label text. Product identity stays consistent; the framing, scale, lighting and surrounding environment should serve this shot's purpose. Do not invent a back view or details that the reference does not establish.
Product identity: TS6 有益菌 PLUS+. Merchant-supplied facts: 盒裝 30 包；包裝標示每包 2 g。

添加水溶性膳食纖維。
食用量與保存方式依實際包裝標示。
日常補充情境不代表疾病治療或效果保證。. Do not turn those facts into visible text.
Visual goal (scene and framing only): 商品主視覺 / frame 1. Clean and credible wellness product composition without invented certificates, doctors or medical symbolism. Build a visually distinct composition; keep photography dominant and avoid a packshot with a long paragraph..
This request is a photograph layer; diagrams, captions and copy will be composed separately. Suitable adult people, hands, clothing, known food ingredients and serving props are allowed when the planned scene calls for them. Do not present props as included accessories. Never invent medical results, unseen product interiors, certificates, unsupported statistics or health transformations. No additional typography or watermarks; preserve existing product marks.
